name: Radio Equipment Directive Article 3(3) cybersecurity essential requirements
description: Activation of cybersecurity essential requirements under the Radio Equipment Directive (2014/53/EU) Article 3(3) for internet-connected radio equipment. Mandatory for radio equipment placed on the EU market from 1 August 2025.
